name: Decision Room AI
tagline: Turn difficult choices into clear, defensible decisions.
description: Decision Room AI replaces vague pros-and-cons lists with a proactive, saved decision workspace. Start with one decision prompt and Anna drafts realistic options, a deadline, weighted criteria, initial scores with reasoning, clarifying questions, assumptions, risks, trade-offs, and a five-cause premortem. Review and edit the draft, inspect why an option leads and whether weight shifts change the result, then confirm or revise Anna's recommendation, confidence, rationale, and next action before committing. The complete Frame → Compare → Challenge → Coach → Commit → Review record syncs through Anna Storage. No separate API key or bundled Executa is required.
changelog: Marketplace review update: adds an automatic Anna first draft, suggested weights and scores with reasoning, proactive clarification, assumptions, risks and five-cause premortem, clearer Compare analysis, editable Commit recommendation, exact review-date display, and a documented tool-less Anna LLM + Storage permission architecture.
